## Findings
- 2026-10-31 (TASK.md, xarray #7233): `Coarsen.construct` demoted non-dim coords. Cause: `rolling.py:976` computed `set(window_dim) & set(self.obj.coords)` — dim names vs coord names, always disjoint unless names collide. Fix: `should_be_coords = set(self.obj.coords)`. test_coarsen 97p/100s, test_rolling 907p/948s/2xf. Not committed.
- Env: run from work dir with `C:/Users/agent/work/projects/stack/campaign/.venv/bin/python` (numpy 2.5.4, pandas 3.1.0). System `numexpr`/`bottleneck` (numpy-1.x builds) emit loud but non-fatal warnings — xarray catches them; filter stderr, don't "fix" them. `dtypes.py:43` needed `np.unicode_`→`np.str_` (numpy 2 removed the alias) to import at all.
